---
applyTo: "**/*.md"
description: "Documentation quality and truthfulness rules"
---

Write English-first documentation with concise headings and actionable commands. Label targets as targets until measured. Link evidence for coverage, compatibility, benchmarks, and release claims. Keep Gate-OS, Ultra Cube, Ultra Zone, and Ultra AI names consistent. Include accessibility, licensing, security, and WSL caveats where relevant. Avoid keyword stuffing and marketing claims without evidence.
